test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The plant will die unless you will water it every day.
solution:
The correct sentence is- 'you will water' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given sentence, the verb '*will*' is incorrectly used.
 
• As the given sentence is a **conditional sentence**. So the *main clause *should be in the **future tense **and the *subordinate clause *will be in the **present indefinite tense**.
 
• Let's understand the structure of the conditional sentence:
 
 
• *simple future tense [main clause] + if/unless + simple present tense [subordinate clause].*
 
 
• ​​Example: ***I will **go to the movie if **I complete **my homework.*
 
 
 
 
 
• So to make the sentence correct remove the **helping **verb *will*. 
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

And the correct sentence is: *The plant will die unless you water it every day.** * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **First **conditional sentences are used to express situations in which the outcome is likely (*but not guaranteed*) to happen in the future.

 
 
• Examples: 
 
• *If you rest, you will feel better.*
 
• *If you set your mind to a goal, you’ll eventually achieve it.*
